intrebari.intrebare: The miller's ______ claims about his daughter put her life in danger. (EXAGGERATE)
intrebari.explicatie: The past participle works as an adjective: exaggerated claims = claims that make things seem bigger than they are.

intrebari.intrebare: The witch's spell left the brave prince utterly ______. (POWER)
intrebari.explicatie: power + -less = without power; we need an adjective after 'left ... utterly'.

intrebari.intrebare: Snow White's stepmother was ______ jealous of her. (OBSESS)
The prince's ______ eventually broke the enchantment. (PERSIST)
The twelve princesses ______ their father every night by sneaking out to dance. (OBEY)
Rapunzel's tower was ______: it had no door and no staircase. (ACCESS)
Cinderella bore her stepmother's cruelty with ______ dignity. (FAIL)
The fairy warned that her gifts were ______: once given, they could not be taken back. (REVOKE)
intrebari.explicatie: revoke → revocable (k becomes c); the negative prefix in- becomes ir- before 'r'.

intrebari.intrebare: The ugly duckling's ______ into a beautiful swan astonished everyone. (TRANSFORM)
The wolf's ______ of the grandmother was convincing enough to fool Little Red Riding Hood. (IMPERSONATE)
intrebari.explicatie: Verbs ending in -ate form nouns in -ation.

intrebari.intrebare: The emperor refused to admit his ______ for fear of looking foolish. (IGNORE)
The Beast's terrible temper was almost ______. (CONTROL)
intrebari.explicatie: Spelling: the final -l is doubled before -able: control → controllable.

intrebari.intrebare: The tailor was ______ proud of killing 'seven at one blow'. (REASON)
intrebari.explicatie: un- + reason + -able + -ly; -able becomes -ably in the adverb.

intrebari.intrebare: The hare's ______ cost him the race. (CONFIDENT)
intrebari.explicatie: over- means 'too much': overconfidence = too much confidence.

intrebari.intrebare: The dwarfs ______ the danger posed by the old pedlar woman. (ESTIMATE)
intrebari.explicatie: under- means 'too little': underestimate = think something is less serious than it is.

intrebari.intrebare: Selling the cow for a handful of beans was ______ foolish, or so Jack's mother thought. (DENY)
The prince's ______ to find Cinderella showed his true devotion. (DETERMINE)
The king could not ______ between the real bride and the false one. (DIFFERENT)
intrebari.explicatie: different + -iate forms the verb 'differentiate' (to see the difference).

intrebari.intrebare: Far from being worthless, the magic beans proved to be ______. (PRICE)
intrebari.explicatie: Here -less is a paradox: priceless = so valuable that no price could be put on it.

intrebari.intrebare: The stepsisters' behaviour at the ball was utterly ______. (EXCUSE)
The huntsman ______ spared Snow White's life. (MERCY)
intrebari.explicatie: mercy → merciful → mercifully; 'mercilessly' would mean the opposite.

intrebari.intrebare: Rumpelstiltskin's demand for the queen's firstborn child was ______. (CONSCIENCE)
intrebari.explicatie: unconscionable = so unfair or cruel that it should not be allowed.

intrebari.intrebare: The fisherman's wife was never content; her ______ grew with every wish. (SATISFY)
The prince ______ a perilous journey through the thorny forest. (TAKE)
intrebari.explicatie: undertake (past: undertook) = begin a task or journey. 'Overtook' and 'mistook' have different meanings.

intrebari.intrebare: The old woman's apples looked perfectly ______, but they were poisoned. (HARM)
intrebari.explicatie: harm + -less = not able to cause harm; an adjective is needed after 'looked'.

intrebari.intrebare: The parents' ______ of Hansel and Gretel is one of the darkest moments in the tale. (ABANDON)
Beauty's initial ______ of the Beast slowly turned into love. (LIKE)
intrebari.explicatie: dis- + like: a noun meaning a feeling of not liking someone.

intrebari.intrebare: Although the wicked fairy was ______ by the good fairies, her curse could not be undone. (NUMBER)
intrebari.explicatie: out- means 'more than': outnumbered = the others were more numerous.

intrebari.intrebare: The frog's ______ surprised the princess, who had never heard an animal speak. (TALK)
Pinocchio's nose grew whenever he told an ______. (TRUE)
The princess's extraordinary ______ to a single pea proved that she was a real princess. (SENSE)
Bluebeard's wife opened the forbidden door out of ______. (CURIOUS)
Gretel ______ the witch by pretending not to understand how to check the oven. (WIT)
intrebari.explicatie: outwit = defeat someone by being cleverer; the final -t is doubled: outwitted.

intrebari.intrebare: The whole castle fell into a deep, ______ sleep. (BREAK)
The queen's attempts to kill Snow White were ultimately ______. (SUCCESS)
Out of fear, the courtiers praised the emperor's ______ clothes. (EXIST)
The tin soldier remained ______ loyal to the paper ballerina. (WAVER)
Beauty was ______ when the Beast turned into a handsome prince. (SPEAK)
intrebari.explicatie: speak → speech (noun) → speechless = unable to speak from surprise.

intrebari.intrebare: The cruel stepmother showed no sign of ______. (REPENT)
The fairy's ______ prediction came true on the princess's sixteenth birthday. (OMEN)
intrebari.explicatie: omen → ominous (spelling change -en- → -in-): suggesting that something bad will happen.
